```{r setup, include = FALSE}
setup_file <- c("R/00_setup.R", "../R/00_setup.R")
source(setup_file[file.exists(setup_file)][1])
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = PROJ)
library(ggplot2)
```

This report creates **every** table body (`tables/*.tex`), figure (`figures/*.pdf`)
and the macro file `essay/numbers.tex` used by the essay. Nothing is typed by hand.

```{r load}
log_open("09")
P   <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "prepared.rds"))
CT  <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "ctt.rds"))
IRT <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "irt_binary.rds"))
DIF <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "dif.rds"))
CFA <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "cfa.rds"))
REL <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "reliability.rds"))
MI  <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "invariance.rds"))
GRM <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "grm.rds"))

FIT_FAMILY <- "scaled"     # "scaled" or "robust": which CFI/RMSEA family the tables report
ORD  <- ITEM_ORDER
SUB1 <- function(i) substr(SUBSCALE_OF[paste0("dass", i)], 1, 1)
COL  <- c(Depression = "#31527d", Anxiety = "#a4243b", Stress = "#3f7d5c")
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "serif") +
          theme(legend.position = "top", strip.background = element_blank()))
save_fig <- function(p, file, w = 6.3, h = 2.8) {
  ggsave(file.path(FIGS, file), p, width = w, height = h, device = "pdf"); print(p)
}
side_by_side <- function(p1, p2) gridExtra::arrangeGrob(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
```

# 1. Tables

```{r tab-descriptives}
d <- CT$desc; it <- CT$item_total
rows <- sapply(ORD, function(i) paste(c(i, SUB1(i), f2(d$mean[i]), f2(d$sd[i]),
  sprintf("%.0f", c(d$p0[i], d$p1[i], d$p2[i], d$p3[i])),
  dec(it$r_drop[i]), dec(it$r_drop_own_subscale[i]),
  dec(IRT$A$p[i]), dec(IRT$B$p[i])), collapse = " & "))
write_rows(paste0(rows, " \\\\"), "tab_descriptives"); head(rows, 3)
```

```{r tab-ctt}
om  <- c(Total = REL$omega_uni, REL$omega_sub)
omg <- c(Total = REL$gy$uni, REL$gy$sub)
rows <- sapply(c("Total", names(SCALES)), function(s) { v <- CT$ctt[[s]]
  paste(c(s, v$k, f2(v$mean), f2(v$sd), f2(v$skew), dec(v$avg_r),
          sprintf("%s [%s, %s]", dec(v$alpha, 3), dec(v$alpha_lo, 3), dec(v$alpha_hi, 3)),
          dec(om[[s]], 3), dec(omg[[s]], 3), f2(v$sem)), collapse = " & ") })
write_rows(paste0(rows, " \\\\"), "tab_ctt"); rows
```

```{r tab-irt}
A <- IRT$A; B <- IRT$B
rows <- sapply(ORD, function(i) paste(c(i, SUB1(i), dec(A$p[i]), f2(A$b_cml[i]), f2(A$se_cml[i]),
  f2(A$infit[i]), f2(A$outfit[i]), f2(A$a[i]), f2(A$se_a[i]), f2(A$b[i]), f2(A$se_b[i])), collapse = " & "))
write_rows(paste0(rows, " \\\\"), "tab_irt_A")
rows <- sapply(ORD, function(i) paste(c(i, SUB1(i), dec(B$p[i]), f2(B$b_cml[i]), f2(B$infit[i]),
  f2(B$outfit[i]), f2(B$a[i]), f2(B$b[i])), collapse = " & "))
write_rows(paste0(rows, " \\\\"), "tab_irt_B")
rows <- unlist(lapply(c("A", "B"), function(r) { o <- IRT[[r]]; an <- o$anova
  c(paste(c(paste("Rule", r), "1PL", mirt::extract.mirt(o$m1, "nest"),
            sprintf("%.1f", mirt::extract.mirt(o$m1, "logLik")),
            sprintf("%.0f", mirt::extract.mirt(o$m1, "AIC")), sprintf("%.0f", mirt::extract.mirt(o$m1, "BIC")),
            "", ""), collapse = " & "),
    paste(c("", "2PL", mirt::extract.mirt(o$m2, "nest"),
            sprintf("%.1f", mirt::extract.mirt(o$m2, "logLik")),
            sprintf("%.0f", mirt::extract.mirt(o$m2, "AIC")), sprintf("%.0f", mirt::extract.mirt(o$m2, "BIC")),
            sprintf("%.1f", an$X2[2]), if (an$p[2] < .001) "$<.001$" else dec(an$p[2], 3)), collapse = " & ")) }))
write_rows(paste0(rows, " \\\\"), "tab_irt_models"); rows
```

```{r tab-cfa}
ft <- CFA$fit_tab
labs <- c(M1 = "M1. Unidimensional", M2 = "M2. Correlated three-factor",
          M3 = "M3. Second-order\\textsuperscript{a}", M4 = "M4. Bifactor")

rows <- sapply(names(labs), function(m) paste(c(labs[m], ft[m, "npar"],
  sprintf("%.1f", ft[m, "chisq.scaled"]), ft[m, "df.scaled"], dec(ft[m, cfi], 3), dec(ft[m, tli], 3),
  if (FIT_FAMILY == "scaled") sprintf("%s [%s, %s]", dec(ft[m, rm], 3), dec(ft[m, "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled"], 3),
                                      dec(ft[m, "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled"], 3)) else dec(ft[m, rm], 3),
  dec(ft[m, "srmr"], 3)), collapse = " & "))
write_rows(paste0(rows, " \\\\"), "tab_cfa_fit"); rows
```

```{r tab-dimensionality}
s <- REL$sub_bi
rows <- c(
  sprintf("$\\omega$, unidimensional model (linear) & %s & sum-score variance due to one common factor (latent-response metric) \\\\", dec(REL$omega_uni, 3)),
  sprintf("$\\omega$, unidimensional model (Green--Yang) & %s & same, in the metric of the observed 0--3 scores \\\\", dec(REL$gy$uni, 3)),
  sprintf("$\\omega_{T}$, bifactor & %s & variance due to general \\emph{and} specific factors \\\\", dec(REL$omegaT, 3)),
  sprintf("$\\omega_{H}$, bifactor (linear) & %s & variance due to the general factor alone \\\\", dec(REL$omegaH, 3)),
  sprintf("$\\omega_{H}$, bifactor (Green--Yang) & %s & same, observed-score metric \\\\", dec(REL$gy$H, 3)),
  sprintf("$\\omega_{H}/\\omega_{T}$ & %s & share of reliable variance due to the general factor \\\\", dec(REL$omegaH / REL$omegaT, 3)),
  sprintf("ECV & %s & share of common variance explained by the general factor \\\\", dec(REL$ECV, 3)),
  sprintf("PUC & %s & share of item correlations not affected by the specific factors \\\\", dec(REL$PUC, 2)),
  sprintf("Factor determinacy, general & %s & correlation of factor-score estimates with the factor \\\\", dec(REL$FD$M4[1], 3)),
  sapply(seq_along(SCALES), function(k) sprintf(
```

```{r tab-omega}
tex_lab <- c("Cronbach's $\\alpha$ (raw item scores)", "Ordinal $\\alpha$ (polychoric correlations)",
  "$\\omega$, unidimensional CFA (linear)", "$\\omega$, unidimensional CFA (Green--Yang)",
  "$\\omega_{T}$, bifactor CFA (linear)", "$\\omega_{T}$, bifactor CFA (Green--Yang)",
  "$\\omega_{H}$, bifactor CFA (linear)", "$\\omega_{H}$, bifactor CFA (Green--Yang)",
  "$\\omega_{H}$, EFA + Schmid--Leiman", "$\\omega_{T}$, EFA + Schmid--Leiman")

  paste(tex_lab[k], met[[REL$compare$metric[k]]], dec(REL$compare$value[k], 3), sep = " & "))
write_rows(paste0(rows, " \\\\"), "tab_omega"); rows
```

```{r tab-invariance}
mi_rows <- function(mi, label) {
  tb <- mi$tab; dl <- mi$deltas
  cfi <- paste0("cfi.", FIT_FAMILY); rm <- paste0("rmsea.", FIT_FAMILY)
  dc  <- paste0("dCFI_", FIT_FAMILY); dr <- paste0("dRMSEA_", FIT_FAMILY)
  sg  <- function(x) sub("^([+-])0\\.", "\\1.", sprintf("%+.3f", x))
  pv  <- function(p) if (p < .001) "$<.001$" else dec(p, 3)
  steps <- c(configural = "Configural", metric = "Metric", scalar = "Scalar", strict = "Strict")
  out <- sapply(seq_along(steps), function(k) { st <- names(steps)[k]
    base <- c(if (k == 1) label else "", steps[k], sprintf("%.1f", tb[st, "chisq.scaled"]),
              tb[st, "df.scaled"], dec(tb[st, cfi], 3), dec(tb[st, rm], 3))
    dlt <- if (k == 1) rep("", 4) else { r <- dl[k - 1, ]
      c(sprintf("%.1f (%d)", r$dchisq, r$ddf), pv(r$p), sg(r[[dc]]), sg(r[[dr]])) }
    paste(c(base, dlt), collapse = " & ") })
  r <- dl[4, ]
  c(out, paste(c("", "\\emph{Scalar vs.\\ configural}", "", "", "", "",
                 sprintf("%.1f (%d)", r$dchisq, r$ddf), pv(r$p), sg(r[[dc]]), sg(r[[dr]])), collapse = " & "))
}
g_rows <- c(paste0(mi_rows(MI$gender_corr3, "Three-factor"), " \\\\"), "\\addlinespace",
            paste0(mi_rows(MI$gender_unidim, "One-factor"), " \\\\"))
write_rows(g_rows, "tab_invariance")
a_rows <- c(paste0(mi_rows(MI$age_corr3, "Three-factor"), " \\\\"), "\\addlinespace",
            paste0(mi_rows(MI$age_unidim, "One-factor"), " \\\\"))
write_rows(a_rows, "tab_invariance_age"); g_rows
```

```{r tab-grm}

write_rows(paste0(rows, " \\\\"), "tab_poly_models"); rows
```

# 2. Figures

```{r fig-distributions, fig.height = 3.4}
df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ORD, function(i) data.frame(item = factor(i, levels = ORD),
  sub = SUBSCALE_OF[paste0("dass", i)], cat = factor(0:3),
  pct = 100 * as.numeric(prop.table(table(factor(P$items[[paste0("dass", i)]], 0:3)))))))
p <- ggplot(df, aes(item, pct, fill = cat)) + geom_col(width = .8, colour = "white", linewidth = .2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#f0f0f0", "#bdbdbd", "#7f7f7f", "#3a3a3a"), name = "Response category") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(7.5, 14.5), linetype = 3, linewidth = .3) +
  annotate("text", x = c(4, 11, 18), y = 104, label = names(SCALES), size = 2.8, family = "serif") +
  labs(x = "Item", y = "Percentage of respondents")
save_fig(p, "fig_distributions.pdf", h = 3.3)
```

```{r fig-icc}
th <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 300)
icc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:21, function(j) data.frame(theta = th, item = j,
  sub = SUBSCALE_OF[ITEMS[j]], P = plogis(A$a[j] * (th - A$b[j])))))
p1 <- ggplot(icc, aes(theta, P, group = item, colour = sub)) + geom_line(linewidth = .35, alpha = .8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COL, name = NULL) + labs(x = expression(theta), y = "P(X = 1)", title = "All 21 items")
sel <- c(11, 13, 21, 2)
p2 <- ggplot(subset(icc, item %in% sel), aes(theta, P, linetype = factor(item))) + geom_line(linewidth = .6) +
  scale_linetype_discrete(name = NULL, labels = sprintf("item %d (a = %.2f, b = %+.2f)", sel[order(sel)],
                                                       A$a[sort(sel)], A$b[sort(sel)])) +
  labs(x = expression(theta), y = NULL, title = "Selected items") + theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(.3, .8))
g <- side_by_side(p1, p2); ggsave(file.path(FIGS, "fig_icc.pdf"), g, width = 6.3, height = 2.9, device = "pdf")
grid::grid.draw(g)
```

```{r fig-dif}
gd <- DIF$gender_A; gd$sub <- SUBSCALE_OF[ITEMS]
p1 <- ggplot(gd, aes(factor(item), delta_mh, fill = sub)) + geom_col(width = .7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1.5, -1, 1, 1.5), linetype = c(2, 3, 3, 2), linewidth = .3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = .3) + scale_fill_manual(values = COL, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Item", y = expression(Delta[MH]), title = "Mantel-Haenszel effect size") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6))
worst <- gd$item[which.max(gd$dR2)]
fits_g <- lapply(levels(P$gender), function(lv)
  mirt::mirt(as.data.frame(P$bin_A[P$gender == lv, ]), 1, "2PL", verbose = FALSE))
cg <- lapply(fits_g, function(m) mirt::coef(m, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)$items[worst, ])
dd <- rbind(data.frame(theta = th, P = plogis(cg[[1]]["a"] * (th - cg[[1]]["b"])), group = "Group 1"),
            data.frame(theta = th, P = plogis(cg[[2]]["a"] * (th - cg[[2]]["b"])), group = "Group 2"))
p2 <- ggplot(dd, aes(theta, P, linetype = group)) + geom_line(linewidth = .6) +
  labs(x = expression(theta), y = "P(X = 1)", linetype = NULL,
       title = sprintf("Item %d, calibrated separately by group", worst)) + theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(.2, .85))
g <- side_by_side(p1, p2); ggsave(file.path(FIGS, "fig_dif.pdf"), g, width = 6.3, height = 2.9, device = "pdf")
grid::grid.draw(g)
```

```{r fig-residuals, fig.height = 3.2}
hm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(c(M1 = 1, M4 = 1)), function(m) {
  M <- CFA$residuals[[m]][paste0("dass", ORD), paste0("dass", ORD)]; diag(M) <- NA
  data.frame(i = factor(rep(ORD, 21), levels = ORD), j = factor(rep(ORD, each = 21), levels = rev(ORD)),

}))

p <- ggplot(hm, aes(i, j, fill = r)) + geom_tile() + facet_wrap(~model) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", high = "#b2182b", limits = c(-.2, .2), na.value = "white",

  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 5), legend.position = "right")
save_fig(p, "fig_residuals.pdf", h = 3.1)
```

# 3. Additional numbers quoted in the prose

```{r prose-numbers}
top_pairs <- function(M, k) { M[lower.tri(M, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
  o <- order(abs(M), decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)[1:k]
  data.frame(i = sub("dass", "", rownames(M)[row(M)[o]]), j = sub("dass", "", colnames(M)[col(M)[o]]), r = M[o]) }
tp <- top_pairs(CFA$residuals$M1, 3); print(tp)
words <- c("One", "Two", "Three")
for (k in 1:3) {
  num(paste0("ResidPair", words[k]), sprintf("%s and %s", tp$i[k], tp$j[k]))
  num(paste0("ResidVal", words[k]), dec(tp$r[k]))
}
num("NItemsModalZero", sum(apply(CT$desc[, c("p0", "p1", "p2", "p3")], 1, which.max) == 1))
## limited-information fit of the 2PL (rule A) and of the GRM; S-X2 item fit
num("MtwoRMSEAtwoPLA", dec(IRT$A$M2$RMSEA, 3)); num("MtwoCFItwoPLA", dec(IRT$A$M2$CFI, 3))
num("MtwoSRMSRtwoPLA", dec(IRT$A$M2$SRMSR, 3))
num("SXtwoMisfitA", sum(IRT$A$itemfit$p.S_X2 < .05))
num("SXtwoMisfitBHA", sum(p.adjust(IRT$A$itemfit$p.S_X2, "BH") < .05))
if (!is.null(GRM$itemfit)) num("GRMSXtwoMisfitBH", sum(GRM$itemfit$p_bh < .05))
if (is.data.frame(GRM$M2)) num("GRMMtwoSRMSR", dec(GRM$M2$SRMSR, 3))
num("MeanSEGRM", f2(mean(GRM$se))); num("MeanSEA", f2(mean(A$se_theta))); num("MeanSEB", f2(mean(B$se_theta)))
## DIF: method-specific sets and direction
g <- DIF$gender_A
num("DIFSigMH", paste(g$item[g$mh_p_bh < .05], collapse = ", ")); num("DIFNSigMH", sum(g$mh_p_bh < .05))
num("DIFNSigLord", sum(g$lord_p_bh < .05, na.rm = TRUE))
num("DIFFocalMore", paste(g$item[g$lr_p_bh < .05 & g$delta_mh > 0], collapse = ", "))
num("DIFRefMore",   paste(g$item[g$lr_p_bh < .05 & g$delta_mh < 0], collapse = ", "))
## invariance: partial model and threshold releases
for (k in seq_along(SCALES)) num(paste0("KappaPartial", names(SCALES)[k]), f2(MI$partial_top4$latent[k]))
num("PartialNSigBH", sum(MI$partial$p_bh < .05))
## construct replicability H of the specific factors
for (k in seq_along(SCALES)) num(paste0("HSpec", names(SCALES)[k]), dec(REL$H[k + 1], 3))
num("MaxPctCatThree", formatC(max(CT$desc$p3), format = "f", digits = 1))
num("FitFamily", FIT_FAMILY)
write_numbers()
cat("Macros written:", length(.NUMBERS$vals), "\n")
log_close()
```
